verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              दुःशासनरथं दृष्ट्वा समीपे पर्यवस्थितम्। भारद्वाजस्ततो वाक्यं दुःशासनमथाब्रवीत् ॥१॥
दुःशासन रथाः सर्वे कस्माच्चैते प्रविद्रुताः। कच्चित्क्षेमं तु नृपतेः कचिज्जीवति सैन्धवः ॥२॥
राजपुत्रो भवानत्र राजभ्राता महारथः। किमर्थं द्रवते युद्धे यौवराज्यमवाप्य हि ॥३॥
verses.english: You are the son of a king, the brother of a king and a mighty car-warrior; why then do you fly away? Constitute yourself the Princeregent (by making your brother the king)?

verses.sanskrit: न सन्ति पतयः सर्वे तेद्य षण्ढतिलैः समाः। दुःशासनैवं कस्मात्त्वं पूर्वमुक्त्वा पलायसे ॥५॥
स्वयं वैरं महत्कृत्वा पञ्चालैः पाण्डवैः सह। एकं सात्यकिमासाद्य कथं भीतोऽसि संयुगे ॥६॥
verses.english: Having yourself provoked inveterate enmity with the Panchalas and the Pandavas, why do you now fly, out of fear, obtaining Satyaki alone in battle for your opponent?

verses.sanskrit: न जानीषे पुरा त्वं तु गृह्णन्नक्षान्‌ दुरोदरे। शरा ह्येते भविष्यन्ति दारुणाशीविषोपमाः ॥७॥
अप्रियाणां हि वचसां पाण्डवस्य विशेषतः। द्रौपद्याश्च परिक्लेशस्त्वन्मूलोह्यभवत् पुरा ॥८॥
verses.english: It were you who formerly abused the Pandavas in filthy language; you were the cause of all the wocs of Draupadi.

verses.sanskrit: क्व ते मानश्च दर्पश्च क्व ते वीर्यं क्व गर्जितम्। आशीविषसमान् पार्थान् कोपयित्वा क्व यास्यसि ॥९॥
verses.english: Where your pride, your haughtiness and brag? Having provoked the Parthas who are like so may snakes of virulent poison, where do you intend to fly?

verses.sanskrit: शोच्येयं भारती सेना राज्यं चैव सुयोधनः। यस्य त्वं कर्कशो भ्राता पलायनपरायणः ॥१०॥
नतु नाम त्वया वीर दीर्यमाणा भयार्दिता। स्वबाहुबलमास्थाय रक्षितव्या ह्यनीकिनी ॥११॥
verses.english: Indeed, O hero, this army, shattered and afflicted with fear as it is, ought to be protected by you, by your own strength of arms.

verses.sanskrit: स त्वमद्य रणं हित्वा भीतो हर्षयसे परान्। विद्रुते त्वयि सैन्यस्य नायके शत्रुसूदन ॥१२॥
verses.english: But you now, leaving the fight, are affording delight unto your foes. O slayer of foes, when you, the leader of the host are flying away. are 110W

verses.sanskrit: कोऽन्यः स्थास्यति संग्रामे भीतो भीते व्यपाश्रये। एकेन सात्वतेनाद्य युध्यमानस्य तेन वै ॥१३॥
verses.english: Who, seized with panic as he is, will care to remain, in the field of battle? Encountering that single-handed warriors of the Satvata race.

verses.sanskrit: पलायने तव मतिः संग्रामाद्धि प्रवर्तते। यदा गाण्डीवधन्वानं भीमसेनं च कौरव ॥१४॥
verses.english: Your heart is inclined to fly away from battle. What then, O Kaurava, will you do when you will see the wielder of the Gandiva in battle or Bhimasena of the twins, Nakula and Sahadeva. The arrows of Satyaki, afraid of which you are seeking to fly away, are scarcely equal to those of Arjuna, that resemble the sun or the fire in effulgence? If your heart is intent on flying away.

verses.sanskrit: यमौ वा युधि द्रष्टासि तदा त्वं किं करिष्यसि। युधि फाल्गुनबाणानां सूर्याग्निसमवर्चसाम् ॥१५॥
न तुल्याः सात्यकिशरा येषां भीतः पलायसे। त्वरितो वीर गच्छ त्वं गान्धार्युदरमाविश ॥१६॥
पृथिव्यां धावमानस्य नान्यत् पश्यामि जीवनम्। यदि तावत्कृता बुद्धिः पलायनपरायणा ॥१७॥
verses.english: O brave warrior! Go immediately and reenter in the ovary of Gandhari, your mother. Because, there is o other place on this earth capable to defend you if you depart from the battle-field.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवी धर्मराजाय शमेनैव प्रदीयताम्। यावत्फाल्गुननाराचा निर्मुक्तोरगसन्निभाः ॥१८॥
verses.english: Then let the sovereignty of the earth be given to king Yudhishthira the virtuous shafts of Phalguna looking like snakes divested of their slough.

verses.sanskrit: नाविशन्ति शरीरं ते तावत्संशाम्य पाण्डवैः। यावत्ते पृथिवीं पार्था हत्वा भ्रातृशतं रणे ॥१९॥
verses.english: Penetrate into your body, let peace of Pritha slaying your hundred brothers snatch the earth away by force, conclude peace with the Pandavas. Before king Yudhishthira is excited with wrath.

verses.sanskrit: नाक्षिपन्ति महात्मानस्तावत्संशाम्य पाण्डवैः। यावन्न क्रुद्ध्यते राजा धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥२०॥
कृष्णश्च समरश्लाघी तावत्संशाम्य पाण्डवैः। यावद्भीमो महाबाहुर्विगाह्य महतीं चमूम् ॥२१॥
verses.english: And Krishna also, that giver of joy, conclude peace with the Pandavas. Before the mighty-armed Bhima, piercing through this vast array of yours.

verses.sanskrit: सोदरांस्ते न गृह्णाति तावत्संशाम्य पाण्डवैः। पूर्वमुक्तश्च ते भ्राता भीष्मेणासौ सुयोधनः ॥२२॥
verses.english: Seizes (and slays) your brothers, conclude peace with the Pandavas. Formerly Bhishma told your brother Suyodhana.

verses.sanskrit: अजेयाः पाण्डवाः संख्ये सौम्य संशाम्य तैः सह। न च तत्कृतवान्मन्दस्तव भ्राता सुयोधनः ॥२३॥
verses.english: “The Pandavas are incapable of being vanquished in battle. O Gentle one, make peace with them.” Your perverted brother Suyodhana however did not listen to him.

verses.sanskrit: स युद्धे धृतिमास्थाय यत्तो युध्यस्व पाण्डवैः। तवापि शोणितं भीमः पास्यतीति मया श्रुतम् ॥२४॥
verses.english: Therefore firmly resolved to fight, battle on heedfully with the Pandavas. I heard that Bhima will drink too your blood. Forsooth, it is true. O fool, do you not aware of the prowess of Bhima. You took the enmity with him, and now escape from the battle field? Proceed quickly on you car, where Satyaki is?

verses.sanskrit: तच्चाप्यवितथं तस्य तत्तथैव भविष्यति। किं भीमस्य न जानासि विक्रमं त्वं सुबालिश ॥२५॥
यत्त्वया वैरमारब्धं संयुगे प्रपलायिना। गच्छ तूर्णं रथेनैव यत्र तिष्ठति सात्यकिः ॥२६॥
त्वया हीनं बलं ह्येतद्विद्रविष्यति भारत। आत्मार्थं योधय रणे सात्यकिं सत्यविक्रमम् ॥२७॥
एवमुक्तस्तव सुतो नाब्रवीत्किञ्चिदप्यसौ। श्रुतं चाश्रुतवत्कृत्वा प्रायाद्येन स सात्यकिः ॥२८॥
सैन्येन महता युक्तो म्लेच्छानामनिवर्तिनाम्। आसाद्य च रणे यत्तो युयुधानमयोधयत् ॥२९॥
verses.english: Supported by a mighty division of unretreating Mlechchas, Dushasana fell upon Satyaki and fought on vigorously.

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणोऽपि रथिनां श्रेष्ठः पञ्चालान् पाण्डवांस्तथा। अभ्यद्रवत संक्रुद्धो जवमास्थाय मध्यमम् ॥३०॥
verses.english: Drona also, that best of car-warriors, inflamed with rage, proceeded against the Panchalas and the Pandavas in medium speed.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य च रणे द्रोणः पाण्डवानां वरूथिनीम्। द्रावयामास योधान् वै शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥३१॥
verses.english: Then Drona, engaging himself in battle, began to crush the Pandava army slaying heroes by hundreds and thousands.

verses.sanskrit: ततो द्रोणो महाराज नाम विश्राव्य संयुगे। पाण्डुपाञ्चालमत्स्यानां प्रचक्रे कदनं महत् ॥३२॥
verses.english: Thereafter, O mighty monarch, proclaiming his name in battle, he began to spread havoc among the ranks of the Pandavas, Panchalas and the Matsyas.

verses.sanskrit: तं जयन्तमनीकानि भारद्वाजं ततस्ततः। पाञ्चालपुत्रो द्युतिमान्वीरकेतुः समभ्ययात् ॥३३॥
verses.english: Thereat the effulgent Viraketu, the Panchala prince, encountered Drona the of Bharadvaja who had been vanquishing his troops.

verses.sanskrit: स द्रोणं पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः। ध्वजमेकेन विव्याध सारथिं चास्य सप्तभिः ॥३४॥
verses.english: Piercing Drona with five shafts of depressed knots, he cut down his standard with one and wounded his charioteer with seven shafts.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राद्भुतं महाराज दृष्टवानस्मि संयुगे। यद्द्रोणो रभसं युद्धे पाञ्चाल्यं नाभ्यवर्तत ॥३५॥
verses.english: Then O mighty monarch, we beheld a wonderful sight in that battle, in as much Drona striving hard could not approach the Panchala prince.

verses.sanskrit: सन्निरुद्धं रणे द्रोणं पञ्चाला वीक्ष्य मारिष। आवव्रुः सर्वतो राजन् धर्मपुत्रजयैषिणः ॥३६॥
verses.english: O sire, then beholding Drona held in check, the Panchalas surrounded him O king, on all son sides, desirous as they were of securing victory to the very virtuous king Yudhishthira.

verses.sanskrit: ते शरैरग्निसंकाशैस्तोमरैश्च महाधनैः। शस्त्रैश्च विविधै राजन् द्रोणमेकमवाकिरन् ॥३७॥
verses.english: They then began to pour upon Drona darts resembling fire, thick showers of Tomaras and numerous other weapons, O king.

verses.sanskrit: निहत्य तान् बाणगणैर्द्रौणो राजन्समन्ततः। महाजलधरान् व्योम्नि मातरिश्वेव चाबभौ ॥३८॥
verses.english: Then baffling those thick showers of arrows by means of his own, like the wind scattering away mighty rain-clouds on the sky, Drona appeared exceedingly beautiful.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शरं महाघोरं सूर्यपावकसन्निभम्। संदधे परवीरघ्नो वीरकेतो रथं प्रति ॥३९॥
verses.english: Thereafter that slayer of hostile heroes viz., Drona aimed at the chariot of Viraketu a dreadful shaft, resembling the sun or fire in splendour.

verses.sanskrit: स भित्वा तु शरो राजन्पाञ्चालकुलनन्दनम्। अभ्यगाद्धरणीं तूर्णं लोहितार्द्रो ज्वलन्निव ॥४०॥
verses.english: O king, then that shaft penetrating through the scion of the Panchala dynasty entered the earth, steeped in blood and burning like a flame of fire.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽपतद्रथात्तूर्णं पाञ्चालकुलनन्दनः। पर्वताग्रादिव महांश्चाम्पको वायुपीडितः ॥४१॥
verses.english: Thereupon that delighter of the Panchala race, quickly fell down from his chariot like a Champaka falling down from the crest of a mountain, being up-rotted by the force of the wind.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् हते महेष्वासे राजपुत्रे महाबले। पञ्चालास्त्वरिता द्रोणं समंतात्पर्यवारयन् ॥४२॥
verses.english: When that highly puissant and fierce bowmen, that prince of the Panchalas, had been slain, the Panchalas, in all haste, surrounded Drona on all sides.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रकेतुः सुधन्वा च चित्रवर्मा च भारत। तथा चित्ररथश्चैव भ्रातृव्यसनकर्शिताः ॥४३॥
अभ्यद्रवन्त सहिता भारद्वाजं युयुत्सवः। मुञ्चन्तः शरवर्षाणि तपान्ते जलदा इव ॥४४॥
verses.english: Unitedly and with a desire for fighting, rushed against the of Bharadvaja, discharging their showers of shafts like so many clouds discharging their contents at the expiration of the summer season.

verses.sanskrit: स वध्यमानो बहुधा राजपुत्रैर्महारथैः। क्रोधमाहारयत्तेषामभावाय द्विजर्षभः ॥४५॥
verses.english: Thus wounded by those princes, all mighty car-warriors, that foremost of the regenerate wrought himself up with anger, for putting an end to their existence.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शरमयं जालं द्रोणस्तेषामवासृजत्। ते हन्यमाना द्रोणस्य शरैराकर्णचोदितैः ॥४६॥
verses.english: Thereafter Drona hurled at them a net-work of Arrows. Those princes, then pierced with those shafts of Drona shot from the bow string drawn back to the very ear.

verses.sanskrit: कर्तव्यं नाभ्यजानन् वै कुमारा राजसत्तम। तान् विमूढान् रणे द्रोणः प्रहसन्निव भारत ॥४७॥
verses.english: Became embarrassed as to what they should do, O foremost of kings. Then when they were thus confounded, Drona with perfect ease.

verses.sanskrit: व्यश्वसूतरथांश्चके कुमारान् कुपितो रणे। अथापरैः सुनिशितैर्भल्लैस्तेषां महायशाः ॥४८॥
verses.english: Inflamed as he was with rage, deprived those princes of their chariots, charioteers and steeds. Thereafter that hero of world-wide fame, with his sharp arrows and Vallas.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पाणीय विचिन्वन्हि सोत्तमाङ्गान्यपातयत्। ते रथेभ्यो हताः पेतुः क्षितौ राजन् सुवर्चसः ॥४९॥
verses.english: Felled their heads, like one culling flowers. O king, those radiant heroes then fell down slain from their respective cars.

verses.sanskrit: देवासुरे पुरा युद्धे यथा दैतेयदानवाः। तान्निहत्य रणे राजन् भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान् ॥५०॥
verses.english: Even as the Daityas and Danavas fell, in the battle between the gods and the Asuras fought in the days of yore. Slaying them in battle, the valorous son of Bharadvaja.

verses.sanskrit: कार्मुकं भ्रामयामास हेमपृष्ठं दुरासदम्। पञ्चालान्निहतान् दृष्ट्वा देवकल्पान्महारथान् ॥५१॥
verses.english: Began to shake his excellent bow whose staff was golden and which was incapable of being approached. Then beholding those Panchala princes all mighty car-warrior and resembling the Pandavas themselves, slain.

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टद्युम्नो भृशोद्विग्नो नेत्राभ्यां पातयञ्जलम्। अभ्यवर्तत संग्रामे क्रुद्धो द्रोणरथं प्रति ॥५२॥
verses.english: Dhrishtadyumna was filled with rage and tears trickled down from his eyes. Then burning with rage, he rushed at the car of Drona.

verses.sanskrit: ततो हाहेति सहसा नादाः समभवन्नृप। पाञ्चाल्येन रणे दृष्ट्वा द्रोणमावारितं शरैः ॥५३॥
verses.english: Thereupon, O king, suddenly cries of Alas and Oh were heard there, for, then Drona was seen covered with the shafts of the Panchala prince Dhrishtadyumna.

verses.sanskrit: स च्छाद्यमानो बहुधा पार्षतेन महात्मना। न विव्यथे ततो द्रोणः स्मयन्नेवान्वयुध्यत ॥५४॥
verses.english: Though covered on all sides by the illustrious son of Prisata, yet Drona flinched not, but fought on smilingly.

verses.sanskrit: ततो द्रोणं महाराज पाञ्चाल्यः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो नवत्या नतपर्वणाम् ॥५५॥
verses.english: Then, O mighty monarch, the Panchala prince, overwhelmed with rage, pierced Drona on the breast with ninety shafts of depressed knots.

verses.sanskrit: स गाढविद्धो बलिना भारद्वाजो महायशाः। निषसाद रथोपस्थे कश्मलं च जगाम ह ॥५६॥
verses.english: Pierced deeply by that powerful hero, the illustrious son of Bharadvaja, squatted down on the terrace of his chariot and fainted away in a

verses.sanskrit: तं वै तथागतं दृष्ट्वा धृष्टद्युम्नः पराक्रमी। चापमुत्सृज्य शीघ्रं तु असिं जग्राह वीर्यवान् ॥५७॥
verses.english: Then beholding him in that plight, Dhrishtadyumna, of fierce energy and great might, grasped his sword and left aside his bow.

verses.sanskrit: अवप्लुत्य रथाच्चापि त्वरितः स महारथः। आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं भारद्वाजस्य मारिष ॥५८॥
हर्तुमिच्छन् शिरः कायात्क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः। प्रत्याश्वस्तस्ततो द्रोणो धनुर्गुह्य महारवम् ॥५९॥
verses.english: With his eyes rolling in rage and urged on by a desire for cutting off Drona's head from the trunk. Meanwhile the puissant Drona, recovering from the swoon, took up his bow.

verses.sanskrit: आसन्नमागतं दृष्ट्वा धृष्टद्युम्नं जिघांसया। शरैर्वैतस्तिकै राजन्विव्याधासनवेधिभिः ॥६०॥
योधयामास समरे धृष्टद्युम्नं महारथम्। ते हि वैतस्तिका नाम शरा आसन्नयोधिनः ॥६१॥
verses.english: But beholding Dhristadyumna inflamed with a desire for slaughtering him so near, he began to pierce him with arrows measuring a span only and so fit to be used in close quarter. Those arrows known by the name of Vaitastika and fit to be used in close quarters.

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणस्य विहिता राजन्यैर्धृष्टद्युम्नमाक्षिणोत्। स वध्यमानो बहुभिः सायकैस्तैर्महाबलः ॥६२॥
verses.english: Where known to Drona only and by means of them, he succeeded in weakening Dhristadyumna's powers. Then the puissant Dhristadyumna wounded with those arrows,

verses.sanskrit: अवप्लुत्य रथात्तूर्णं भग्नवेगः पराक्रमी। आरुह्य स्वरथं वीरः प्रगृह्य च महद्धनुः ॥६३॥
verses.english: Swifty came down from Drona's chariot. That hero of fierce energy was then greatly robbed of his strength. Thereafter ascending his car and taking up a mighty bow.

verses.sanskrit: विव्याध समरे द्रोणं धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः। द्रोणश्चापि महाराज शरैर्विव्याध पार्षतम् ॥६४॥
verses.english: The mighty car-warrior Dhristadyumna began to pierce Drona in battle; Drona also, O mighty monarch, pierced the son of Prisata with numerous shafts in battle.

verses.sanskrit: तद‌द्भुतमभूद्युद्धं द्रोणपाञ्चालयोस्तदा।  त्रैलोक्यकांक्षिणोरासीच्छक्रप्रल्हादयोरिव ॥६५॥
verses.english: Then a wonderful fight was fought between Drona and the Panchala prince, like what was fought between Shakra and the Prahlada, both longing to enjoy the sovereignty of the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: मण्डलानि विचित्राणि यमकानीतराणि च। चरन्तौ युद्धमार्गज्ञौ ततक्षतुरथेषुभिः ॥६६॥
मोहयन्तौ मनांस्याजौ योधानां द्रोणपार्षतौ। सृजन्तौ शरवर्षाणि वर्षास्विव बलाहकौ ॥६७॥
verses.english: Then confounding the minds of the other warriors. Drona and Prisata's son began to pour their arrowy showers like rain-clouds purring their contents in the rainy seasons.

verses.sanskrit: छादयन्तौ महात्मानौ शरैर्व्योमदिशो महीम्। तदद्भुतं तयोर्युद्धं भूतसङ्घा ह्यपूजयन् ॥६८॥
verses.english: Those two high-souled warriors then covered the conclave dome, the earth and the quarters with their shafts. The creatures assembled there, then began to applaud that battle that was fought between them.

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियाश्च महाराज ये चान्ये तव सैनिकाः। अवश्यं समरे द्रोणो धृष्टद्युम्नेन सङ्गतः ॥६९॥
verses.english: So also, O mighty monarch, the Kshatriyas and other soldiers praised that battle. “Meeting Dhristadyumna in battle Drona will surely succumb to him." The Panchalas exclaimed, O king, speaking thus. Then Drona fighting with great agility cut-off the head of Dhristadyumna's charioteer, like one felling ripe fruits from a tree. Thereupon O king, the steeds of the illustrious Dhristadyumna ran away wildly.

verses.sanskrit: वशमेष्यति नो राजन् पञ्चाला इति चुक्रुशुः। द्रोणस्तु त्वरितो युद्धे धृष्टद्युम्नस्य सारथेः ॥७०॥
शिरः प्रच्यावयामास फलं पक्वं तरोरिव। ततस्तु प्रद्रुता वाहा राजंस्तस्य महात्मनः ॥७१॥
तेषु प्रद्रवमाणेषु पञ्चालान् सृञ्जयांस्तथा।  अयोधयद्रणे द्रोणस्तत्र तत्र पराक्रमी ॥७२॥
verses.english: When those steeds thus ran away bearing Dhristadyumna away, Drona of great might began to crush the Panchalas and Srinjayas (mercilessly).

verses.sanskrit: विजित्य पाण्डुपञ्चालान्भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्। स्वं व्यूहं पुनरास्थाय स्थितो भवदरिन्दमः। न चैनं पाण्डवा युद्धे जेतुमुत्सेहिरे प्रभो ॥७३॥
